blocks.text: What we have seen in the year 2008 is only the beginning of the greatest changes which lie directly ahead. These events will bring more proof to the soon return of our Lord Jesus and the Translation of the Elect. Like a shadow it is creeping around the world setting the stage for change directing the world’s path closer and closer to the new system that is about to come. The old system and the old ways are failing. We’re moving into a new time and dimension. Even our election shows a dramatic change from the old ways. The greatest financial change is just ahead. This will bring about a new financial system that Brother Frisby wrote about that will lead them to the anti-Christ worldwide system based on the resources – energy, gold, silver and food. God will guide the Elect through these troublesome times and has placed a blessing upon them. 2009 will be a year of crises and financial failures. The central banks are printing money at an astronomical rate. It started out at $700 billion and now there are numbers out there of over $8 trillion to cover the damages. There is over $650 trillion in derivatives. Finance, insurance and real estate are part of this derivative debt that is so massive that the small trillions will not cover this kind of trouble. (This is a two-part letter and we’ll continue this in the next letter.) – And now a special quote from Neal Frisby.

Signs Ending the Age – “In one of our prophecies we listed . . . watch the territory surrounding Euphrates, the old Assyrian- Babylon Empire – which includes Syria! And lately we have seen Syria grow into strong military prominence.” – “According to Isa. 10:5, verses 12, 30-31 – Dan. 8:9, 22-25, the anti-Christ will dominate all the territory that we spoke about . . . and could go there or actually come out of this section to rule the world!” – “He will also conquer and rule the Arabian Empire; he will make a covenant with them and Israel! And then he will finally sit in a Jewish Temple claiming himself as god the Messiah!” (Rev. 11:2 – II Thess. 2:4 – Dan. 9:26-27) – “By the spirit of prophecy I foresee that he will use science and technology to further himself as a world dictator! – I also foresee that he will do away with the type of currency that the world has now and implement his own standard of wealth and prosperity through his monetary seal! . . . Evidently this is, or works into, the mark of the beast. For out of great chaos and financial crisis he will restore prosperity for awhile!” “Now we will turn our attention to the Translation! So many people ask me, does the Bride go up before the Great Tribulation and who are the ones who do go through the Tribulation?” – “So let’s give some key Scriptures to prove and verify the rapture! In St. Matt.24:27, reveals it occurs as quickly as lightning and the saints are caught up, and in the next verses shows Him “returning with the Bride after” the Tribulation! You see the Translation is very secret, it took the world by surprise! Verse 39.” – “Verses 40- 41 reveal, one shall be taken and one shall be left!” – Matt.25:1-10, “speaks of the same similarity! The Bride is translated, the foolish virgins are left! – More on this in a moment! – Matt. 24:44, “reveals that He will come in an hour that ye think not! – II Thess. 2:3 reveals, first will come a falling away! That is occurring right now!” – “Then verse 6 reveals that the subtle dictator cannot appear in beast form until the “Holy Spirit people” are taken out of the way; and at that moment the Translation occurs! – And then the beast begins to blaspheme and give the mark!” (Rev. 13:5-6)

Rev. 12:5 “shows the man child Bride caught up! Verse 17 reveals the remnant of the woman’s seed is left, which is the Tribulation Saints!” – “The reason people get confused is that they can’t distinguish between the Bride and the Tribulation Saints because they are another class of Christians! – What confuses them, they read in Dan. 7:21 that the anti-Christ made war with the Saints and was given power to wear out the Saints!” (verse 25) –Now let us prove that these Saints are the foolish virgins and the 144,000 Israelite Hebrews that are still here during the Tribulation! – Rev. 7:4, “reveals the 144,000 Israelites are sealed during the Tribulation! Verse 9 reveals after this, there appeared a group that could not be numbered! And verse 14 reveals they are definitely the Tribulation Saints!” – Rev. 13:7, “reveals again that he would make war with the Tribulation Saints, but this was during the last 42 months!” (verse 5) – “The Saints were already gone!” (Rev. 12:5) – “The Bride leaves about the time the mark is issued! (Rev. 13:16) and as we see from verse 5 it was given during the last 42 months! Rev. 4:1-3 also is a type of the catching away of the elect to the rainbow throne!”

Now let us take into consideration the 7-year Jewish covenant. – (Dan. 9:27) – “One week is determined here as 7 years, the anti-Christ prince makes the agreement! In the middle of the 7-yr. period he will break the covenant, cease their sacrifice, sit in the temple claiming he is God!” (II Thess. 2:4) – “The Bride may be here during the first part, but when he breaks the agreement with the Israelites the elect leave! Isa. 28:15 speaks of it as the covenant with death and hell!” – Rev. 11:1-2, “reveals the Jews will build their Temple, and they are even in progress towards it now according to news reports! Time is shortening!” (End quote.) In 2009 a special note, we will be entering the digital world totally. This will be the world that the anti-Christ controls. – This month we are offering two Special Writings, “Prophecy Fulfilling – Harvest Time” and “Daniel’s 70th Week.” Also a new DVD called The Bible Wheel – Part 1 that I know you will enjoy. (See offer below.) – Your continued support of the ministry and your prayers have been wonderful helping us to distribute this vital and important message. My prayer is may the Lord continue to guide you with His wisdom and His love, blessing you in all the things that you do.
